name: Human Resources
description: Business domain covering the people who work for Adventure Works Cycles: employees, the departments and shifts they work in, their pay, and the job candidates who apply to join.

name: Employee
description: A person employed by Adventure Works. Employee information includes salary, department and job title, and an employee is also a person known to the company.

name: Department
description: A department within the Adventure Works Cycles company, belonging to a department group.

name: Department Assignment
description: The department and work shift an employee belongs to over time, including transfers between departments, so that both current and previous departments can be reported.

name: Shift
description: A work shift, the time of day during which employees work.

name: Pay History
description: The history of an employee's pay rate and how often it is paid.

name: Job Candidate
description: A person who has submitted a resume to Human Resources as a job applicant, including the education and employment history held in the resume. A candidate who is hired becomes an employee.
